summary: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a First Amendment to the Merger Agreement with its subsidiary United Dogecoin Inc., reducing the Milestone Event mining-rig threshold from 2,000 to 500 rigs. The amendment adjusts only the milestone trigger, not the maximum pre-funded warrants issuable. The company seeks parallel amendments to related securities purchase and asset purchase agreements, requiring counterparty approvals. This is a post-merger contractual adjustment without new consideration or structural change, so it is classified as Other rather than a standard special situation. Watch for approval completion and potential milestone-driven dilution.
